my company gives me 5 lakh group cover, so why would I pay extra

The 5 lakh cover is part of your employer’s group policy, which means it stays with the company and you only have it while you’re employed there. If you want coverage that follows you, moving to a personal policy may be subject to underwriting, according to IRDAI’s 2020 circular. Does that change how you view the need for your own plan?
